note: Incumbent Dan Sullivan (R) seeks a third term; ranked-choice general election (top four from Aug 18 primary).

cands.name: Dan Sullivan
cands.desc: Two-term incumbent; resource development and military focus; endorsed by Donald Trump, Lisa Murkowski and the U.S. Chamber of Commerce.

cands.name: Mary Peltola
cands.desc: Former U.S. Representative (2022–2025); fisheries, cost of living and bipartisanship focus; endorsed by Alaska AFL-CIO and EMILY's List. Led the Aug 18 primary with 49.5%.

note: Open seat (Mike Dunleavy term-limited); ranked-choice general election. Also on ballot: Dave Bronson (R) and Treg Taylor (R).

cands.name: Jonathan Kreiss-Tomkins
cands.desc: Former state representative from Sitka (2013–2023), running with independent Zac Johnson; endorsed by former Gov. Tony Knowles and Tom Begich after Begich withdrew. Led the primary (22.5%).

cands.name: Bernadette Wilson
cands.desc: Waste-management business founder and conservative activist, running with former Senate minority leader Mike Shower; supports repealing ranked-choice voting; endorsed by Rep. Byron Donalds.
